audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, or .NET 8+ who need local, offline OCR without external services.

capabilities.text: Embeds detection, refinement, and recognition ONNX models directly in the assembly; inference runs locally via ONNX Runtime without external model files.
capabilities.title: Local OCR with embedded models

capabilities.text: Recognizes Latin-script text including diacritical characters supported by the embedded recognition model.
capabilities.title: Latin-script recognition

capabilities.text: Returns `RecognitionLinesResult` with `System.Drawing.Rectangle` coordinates for each detected text line.
capabilities.title: Line-level bounding boxes

capabilities.text: Processes multiple images or PDF pages in one `OcrInput` container, returning results in source order.
capabilities.title: Multi-input processing

limitations.text: Image processing is Windows-only due to dependency on `System.Drawing.Common`.
PDF rendering is fixed at 150 DPI with no configurable resolution.
Only axis-aligned text-line rectangles are returned; polygonal regions and layout labels are not supported.
No runtime language selection API; recognition is limited to the embedded Latin-script model.
No GPU execution provider is configured; inference uses CPU only.
No support for search PDF generation, confidence scores, font detection, table structure, or barcode detection.

problems_solved.text: Enables offline text recognition from images and PDFs without network calls or external model downloads.
Provides structured output with recognized text and line-level bounding box coordinates for layout-aware processing.
Supports batch processing of multiple images or PDF pages in a single API call while preserving input order.

product_summary.text: Aspose.OCR.FOSS is a free, open-source OCR library for .NET that performs local text detection and Latin-script recognition on raster images and PDF documents using embedded ONNX models.

uncertainties: The exact set of Latin characters supported by the embedded recognition model is not explicitly listed.

The impact of image preprocessing steps (e.g., resizing, grayscale conversion) on accuracy is not quantified.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Build the solution using `dotnet build Aspose.Ocr.Foss.sln`.

workflows.name: Install via NuGet
workflows.text: Install the package using `dotnet add package Aspose.OCR.FOSS`.

workflows.name: Recognize PDF pages
workflows.text: Create an `OcrInput` with `InputType.PDF`, add PDF paths, call `AsposeOcr.Recognize`, and iterate over `RecognitionResult` objects.
